definitions.explanation: The period of mourning observed after a death, during which one refrains from celebrations and social activities.

examples.japanese: {服喪|ふくもう}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}える→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧。
examples.english: During mourning, one refrains from going out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{亡|な}くなり→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{服喪|ふくもう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: After our grandmother passed away, the family entered a period of mourning.

examples.japanese: {服喪|ふくもう}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あ}ける→明ける：21288_akeru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧、⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{送付|そうふ}→送付：07345_soufu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{控|ひか}える→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧な⟦マナー→マナー：11139_manaa⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: It is common etiquette to refrain from sending New Year's cards until the mourning period is over.

notes:
Refers to the formal period of mourning observed after the death of a family member or close relative. During {服喪|ふくもう}, people traditionally avoid celebrations, festive events, and sending seasonal greetings.

In Japan, the mourning period (⟦{喪中|もちゅう}→喪中：06226_mochuu⟧) typically lasts about one year for close relatives. During this time, families send ⟦{喪中|もちゅう}→喪中：06226_mochuu⟧⟦はがき→はがき：00699_hagaki⟧ (mourning postcards) before the New Year season to inform others that they will not be sending ⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧ (New Year's cards).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {服喪|ふくもう}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: in mourning
- {服喪|ふくもう}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: mourning period
- {服喪|ふくもう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あ}ける→明ける：21288_akeru⟧: the mourning period ends
- {服喪|ふくもう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter mourning

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{喪中|もちゅう}→喪中：06226_mochuu⟧: in mourning — the state of being in mourning, used more colloquially and on postcards
- ⟦{忌中|きちゅう}→忌中：26041_kichuu⟧: a shorter, stricter mourning period (usually 49 days) immediately following a death
- {弔|とむら}い: mourning, condolence — focuses on the act of paying respects rather than the period
